title: docs(skills, client): deciding an in-app AI pending action is the person's own act, on their signed-in session
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9MdVWiH4D1vGNt7peGkinYV)_

Fixes #34189

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:技能 `objectstack-ai`、`client-sdk.mdx`、`actions-as-tools.mdx` 的 ObjectOS 提示框和 `client.ai.pendingActions` 的注释改成:批准或拒绝应用内 AI 待批动作,只能由发起那次调用的本人,在应用里用自己的登录会话来做;令牌(哪怕是本人的)只能列出,不能决定。加了一个 eval 用例。
- 为什么改:ADR-0087 `in-app-pending-action-decided-by-person` 的规则由 cloud#4607 在应用内的门落地后,这四处还在教「用令牌或 SDK 调 POST 去决定」,照做会被拒。
- 风险与回滚:只改文档和注释文本,无代码行为、导出或类型变化;回滚就是 revert 本 PR。⚠ 落地时机:必须与带 cloud#4607 的 cloud 版本钉位升级同一发布窗口或之后合并,不能更早,否则文档会先于门的行为。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` 的 Human-in-the-loop 段;`content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` 的 Pending actions 注释;`packages/client/src/index.ts` 的 `pendingActions` 注释。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep objectstack-ai/SKILL` 预期 6019 / 6801,全绿。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(在 cloud#4607 的钉位升级同窗或之后合并)。

## What changes

Four teaching sites now say what the in-app door's confirmation rule says: deciding (approve or reject) an in-app AI pending action is the person's own act, on their signed-in session to the app. Listing stays as written.

1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, **Human-in-the-loop** paragraph: drops "an operator approves or rejects … (or via `GET/POST /api/v1/ai/pending-actions/...`)". The queue is listed in the inbox or via `GET /api/v1/ai/pending-actions`. Only the person the call ran as decides, in the app on their signed-in session. Another user's `ai:approve` does not decide it, an API key or token is refused (even the person's own), and a second approver goes through the approvals engine (`held`). Frontmatter untouched.
2. `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`: the "Listing takes `ai:read`, deciding takes `ai:approve`" comment moves above `approve` and now says deciding takes `ai:approve` AND the person's own signed-in session. A client on an API key or token lists but does not decide.
3. `packages/client/src/index.ts`: the `pendingActions` namespace docblock and the `approve` / `reject` docblocks say the same. Docblock text only, no code change.
4. `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx`, ObjectOS callout (about line 236): one sentence. "an operator resolves it from the **AI Pending Actions** Studio inbox (approve re-runs the same dispatcher; reject records a reason)" now says only the person the call ran as decides it in the inbox, on their own signed-in session. Another user's `ai:approve` does not decide it and an API key or token is refused. Approve runs the action as that person with every gate re-checked; reject records a reason. Sources: the spec contract's in-app door section, points 1-3 (**Who decides**, **Which credential**, **As whom it runs**: "never as a synthetic AI principal, through the same admitted sequence as any action call, every gate and permission re-checked"). The seat widened the claimed surface to this sentence (card comment 6905036822). Nothing else in the callout changes.
5. `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`: case 6. An operator script on an API token is asked to approve the queue. Expected: list via the token, decide in the app on the person's session. `must_not_contain` holds `pendingActions.approve(` and `/approve`. Self-consistent: no `must_contain` string is in `must_not_contain`, and `expected_output` contains every `must_contain` string and neither `must_not_contain` string.
6. `.changeset/34189-pending-action-decide-session.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, `@objectstack/client` patch (the docblock ships in its `.d.ts`).

## Premise check (on `origin/main` dfb8ed35)

- **The door.** No package in this repository serves `/api/v1/ai/pending-actions/:id/approve|reject`. `git grep pending-actions` over `packages/services/**` and `packages/plugins/**` has no hits. The only hits are the client (`packages/client/src/index.ts`) and the protocol schemas (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` 4386 and 4403). The door is served by the AI service in cloud, and its refusal is cloud#4607, which this container cannot read. So no refusal code is quoted here. The text says "refused" and names no code. The client's existing `ai:approve` 403 note is kept as written.
- **What main states**, and the source of each sentence in this PR:
  - "only the person the call ran as decides; another user's `ai:approve` does not" comes from `packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`, "The in-app assistant door: the same rule, its own channel", point 1 (**Who decides**).
  - "a signed-in session to the app; an API key or token is refused, even the person's own" comes from the same section, point 2 (**Which credential**): "an API key, a delegated or OAuth token and any other service credential are refused, whoever it resolves to". Rule 4 adds "a person's own API key resolves as that person, and is refused there all the same".
  - "a second approver goes through `held`" comes from point 1: "A host that wants a second person to approve the write uses the existing `held` outcome".
  - The ADR-0087 entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.in-app-pending-action-decided-by-person.ts` (`replacement`) says the same, from the release whose in-app door enforces it.
  - "Listing takes `ai:read`" is the client's existing text. The spec pin `ai-service.test.ts` holds that `listPendingActions` carries none of the deciding points.
- **What each place taught before:** SKILL.md:164-166 "an operator approves or rejects in Studio's **AI Pending Actions** inbox (or via `GET/POST /api/v1/ai/pending-actions/...`)". client-sdk.mdx:426-427 "Listing takes `ai:read`, deciding takes `ai:approve` — a caller that can see the queue may still be refused on approve. Handle the 403." The client docblock taught only the `ai:read` vs `ai:approve` split.
- Because the rule binds only once the cloud door ships, this PR waits for that release (card item 4).

## Tests

- No behaviour change. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client test`: Test Files 58 passed (58), Tests 812 passed (812). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client typecheck`: exit 0, under `os-verify-lock`.
- No forced test edits.

## Acceptance notes

- **Tier.** `skills/**` mandates CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (`dispatch-gates --tier`: MANDATORY, no one-line exit). Measured quota exemption, on the maintainer's 2026-11-15 21:53Z 「fable 不多了，后续契约复审找review 席位」: this PR was authored at the thread's default tier, never lower. The at-tier L2 review is review#2's. Tier H: stays draft.
- **Skill size.** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` went from 427 to 432 lines and from 5929 to 6019 tokens (+90), against a ceiling of 6801. The ratchet row does not move. Whole package (sum of every `skills/*/SKILL.md`): 4593 to 4598 lines, 59219 to 59309 tokens. Bundle total: +334 (247139 to 247473 on base dfb8ed35; 248006 on the merged base). The eval file went from 1081 to 1325 tokens (eval fixtures are measured, not ratcheted).
- **Same family:** `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx` taught the same superseded route. Round 1 reported it to the seat. The seat widened the surface (6905036822), and round 2 fixes that one sentence.

## Verification

Derived gate set, round 2: the head was 6 commits behind `origin/main` (STALE TREE on two gate scripts), so `origin/main` b51cb18a7 was merged in (a plain merge commit). The three packages main moved were rebuilt (`metadata-protocol`, `plugin-audit`, `runtime`; `os-verify-lock` VERDICT command-exit 0). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` then gave the same 102 commands at head 3690b8ef5. All of them and `check:skill-refs` were run on that head. Round 1 ran the same set at cf09e9fb9 after a full `pnpm build` (12m28s), all green.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` result at 3690b8ef5: "102 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 102 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". All 103 recorded commands exit 0. `check:skill-refs` was run outside the derivation.

<details><summary>Notes on the run</summary>

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needs its pinned fixture commit 621a4876 in a shallow clone (`git fetch --no-tags origin 621a487607881c66b2899b7e3477115229a156b4`). With it, it exits 0 with 48 cases.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` at 3690b8ef5 reads `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md is 6019 tokens (ceiling 6801; headroom 782)`. Bundle total 248006 on the merged base, which is +334 over that base, the same delta as round 1.
- Every check-run of the PR is CI's to report.

</details>

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
